name: tab-setter
description: Sample registry entry: a tiny Diode test extension that sets tabSize=7 on activation
readme:
# Tab Setter

A sample entry that exists so the registry has a `native` extension end to end: source file, published card, hosted artifact.

On activation it sets `tabSize=7` and `insertSpaces=false` on the active editor — deliberately unusual values, so a full-cycle test can tell at a glance whether the extension really got installed and activated.

It is a placeholder and will be replaced once Diode has a real first-party extension.
